tasks.title: Implement Catalog Item retrieval by ID
acceptanceCriteria: Given an integer ID, when FindCatalogItem is called, then the system returns the matching CatalogItem.
Given the catalog item exists, when FindCatalogItem is called, then the returned item populates its CatalogBrand and CatalogType properties.
Given the catalog item does not exist, when FindCatalogItem is called, then the system returns a not found indicator.

tasks.title: Implement Paginated Catalog Listing
acceptanceCriteria: Given a page size of 20 and page index 1, when GetCatalogItemsPaginated is called, then the system returns a list containing 20 items.
Given a total of 100 items, when GetCatalogItemsPaginated is called with page size 20, then the total pages calculated must be 5.

tasks.title: Implement Catalog Item Creation
acceptanceCriteria: Given valid data for a new item, when CreateCatalogItem is called, then the system persists the item and assigns it a unique ID.
Given the CreateCatalogItem call includes a temporary image name, when CreateCatalogItem succeeds, then the system calls ImageService to update the image record.
Given required fields (Name) are missing during creation, when CreateCatalogItem is called, then the persistence layer rejects the operation.

tasks.title: Implement Catalog Item Update
acceptanceCriteria: Given an existing item ID, when UpdateCatalogItem is called with modified data, then the system persists the changes after marking the entity as modified.
Given the update includes a temporary image name, when UpdateCatalogItem succeeds, then the system updates the product image record via ImageService.

tasks.title: Implement Catalog Item Deletion
acceptanceCriteria: Given an item ID, when DeleteCatalogItem is called, then the system removes the item record from the data store.
Given the item ID does not exist, when DeleteCatalogItem is called, then the system reports that no item was deleted.

tasks.title: Implement Image URL Generation and Management
acceptanceCriteria: Given a catalog item ID, when BuildImageUrl is called, then a full URI string is constructed using the BaseUrl and ID.
Given a valid item ID and image file, when UploadTempImage is called, then the system returns the generated URI for the blob.
Given an item exists, when InitializeCatalogImages is called, then placeholder images (1.png to 12.png) are created in storage.
Given an item ID, when GetDefaultImageUrl is called, then the system returns the predefined default image URI.

tasks.title: Implement Catalog View Filtering and Display
acceptanceCriteria: Given the CatalogView is initialized, when SetCatalogItems is called, then the data grid is populated with items matching the provided filter/discount logic.
Given a specific Brand or Type is selected in the view, when filterChanged is triggered, then the view refreshes the catalog grid with filtered results.
Given a list of items and a discount value, when SetCatalogItems is called, then the view displays the discount banner if applicable.
Given the view is loaded, when displaying items, then the grid correctly shows Item Name, Description, Brand, Type, Price, and Stock levels.

tasks.title: Implement Catalog Item Delete Confirmation
acceptanceCriteria: Given an item ID is selected for deletion, when the Delete view loads, then it displays all item details (Name, Price, Stock, etc.) for confirmation.
Given the Delete view is displayed, when the user clicks Cancel, then the system redirects to the Index view.
Given the Delete view is displayed, when the user confirms deletion, then the system calls DeleteCatalogItem via the service.
